title: Zelensky says US resumed intelligence sharing on Russian missile attacks
excerpt: Times Now’s source description attributes the announcement to Zelensky following discussions with US envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo.
author: LokkeeVerse
content:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced that the United States has resumed intelligence sharing with Ukraine concerning Russian missile attacks, following diplomatic discussions with US envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo, Norway.

The announcement marks an important development in security cooperation between Washington and Kyiv as Ukraine continues to face Russian aerial attacks.

According to reports published on October 20, 2026, Zelensky said Ukraine was once again receiving intelligence that helps provide advance warnings of incoming ballistic missile attacks.

## Zelensky Welcomes the Return of Intelligence Sharing

Speaking to reporters after meeting with Witkoff in Oslo, Zelensky expressed gratitude for the renewed intelligence cooperation.

He emphasized the importance of early-warning information in helping Ukraine respond to incoming missile threats and protect civilians.

Such warnings can give authorities and residents valuable time to react when ballistic missiles are detected approaching Ukrainian territory.

Zelensky described the cooperation as important for the safety of children, adults and other civilians affected by the ongoing war.

## Talks With US Envoy Steve Witkoff

The announcement followed discussions between Zelensky and Witkoff as diplomatic efforts continued over the war between Ukraine and Russia.

The meeting took place amid wider discussions about security cooperation and possible steps toward ending the conflict.

The resumption of intelligence sharing is significant because information about incoming missile attacks can support Ukraine's early-warning systems and help authorities prepare for potential strikes.

However, the precise scope of the intelligence arrangement and the full details of what information is being shared have not been publicly established in the reports cited here.

## Why Intelligence Sharing Matters to Ukraine

Intelligence cooperation can play an important role in detecting threats before they reach their targets.

For Ukraine, advance warnings of ballistic missile attacks can help authorities activate alerts and give civilians an opportunity to seek shelter.

The information can also support decisions about air defence and emergency responses. However, early warnings do not guarantee that every missile will be intercepted or that casualties can always be prevented.

The latest announcement highlights the continuing importance of international security cooperation as Ukraine faces ongoing Russian attacks.

## What Happens Next?

Zelensky's announcement signals that intelligence cooperation between the United States and Ukraine is functioning again, at least in relation to the early warnings he described.

The longer-term implications will depend on the details of the arrangement and whether the cooperation continues as diplomatic discussions progress.

For now, Ukraine's leadership has welcomed the reported resumption, stressing the importance of receiving timely information about incoming missile threats.

The development comes as Kyiv continues seeking security support from its international partners while diplomatic efforts over the war remain ongoing.
